rationale: Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership LP is the DBFM project company and concessionaire for the Etobicoke General Hospital Phase 1 Patient Tower; the tower and redevelopment names describe the physical project and are not a second manager-level PortCo. Infrastructure Ontario's current project page identifies Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as the winning bidder and Axium Infrastructure Canada and DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. as developers. The May 2016 Axium release directly identifies Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV as the equity sponsors. Lexpert records May 6, 2016 financial close with Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership LP and names DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. Exact sponsor percentages are not publicly disclosed. William Osler Health System's audited statements for the year ended March 31, 2026 continue to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building and state that the project assets transfer to Osler in July 2048. Axium's 2024 PAI statement includes Etobicoke General Hospital among its investee assets. No later project-level sponsor sale, equity transfer, signed pending exit or concession termination was identified through August 18, 2026. CVC's July 2024 acquisition and rebrand of DIF Capital Partners was a manager-level transaction, with individual infrastructure strategies and fund names unchanged. Accordingly, keep the existing Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership company, retire and redirect the phase/project-name duplicate, preserve Axium and CVC DIF once as active 2016 owners with their verified vehicles, and supersede Task 203 only after release, application and production verification.

beforeImage.name: Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership
beforeImage.description: Etobicoke General Hospital Phase 1 Patient Tower is a healthcare public-private partnership project in Ontario. The asset serves the William Osler Health System and the surrounding community through availability-based hospital infrastructure rather than commercial user-pay revenue. Its model is asset-heavy and contract-based because value depends on the construction, financing, and long-term delivery of a major clinical facility. Public project materials describe a new four-storey tower adding about 250,000 square feet to the hospital and housing critical emergency, intensive care, neonatal, and ambulatory services. Financial-close materials in 2016 identified DIF Infrastructure IV and Axium Infrastructure Canada II as equity sponsors, while public sources reviewed do not disclose their exact ownership percentages.

milestones.event: William Osler Health System and Infrastructure Ontario reached financial close with Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership, whose equity sponsors included DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd.
Ontario announced up to C$358 million of provincial investment in the project.
Walsh announced completion of the new patient tower at Etobicoke General Hospital.

afterImage.description: Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership LP is the availability-based design-build-finance-maintain project company for the Etobicoke General Hospital Phase 1 Patient Tower in Toronto, Ontario. The C$330 million project added an approximately 250,000-square-foot, four-storey clinical tower. Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. and DIF Infrastructure IV through DIF Infra 4 Canada Ltd. were the equity sponsors at the May 2016 financial close. Construction reached substantial completion on February 19, 2019. William Osler Health System's audited statements for the year ended March 31, 2026 continue to identify Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership as responsible for operating and maintaining the building, with project assets transferring to Osler in July 2048. Exact sponsor percentages are not publicly disclosed, and no later project-level sponsor sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026.
